## Overview

The Council Accord is the closest thing mortal civilization has to a central authority. It consists of the three kings of the capital cities  -  Skywatch, Emberforge, and Weaveheart  -  who convene to make decisions affecting all three cities and the broader reconquering effort.

## Structure

The Accord has no fixed schedule; the kings gather frequently by tradition, and any one of them may invoke a formal council when matters arise. The structure exists by design to ensure no single point of failure  -  if one city falls, the others continue.

## Membership

- **The King of Skywatch**: Rules with the counsel of the Council of Eyes
- **The King of Emberforge**: Rules with the counsel of the Forgemaster's Circle
- **The King of Weaveheart**: Rules with the counsel of the Arcane Conclave

## Goals

- Coordinate the reconquering effort across all three capitals
- Allocate resources for military campaigns and civilian development
- Mediate disputes between settlements and regions
- Maintain the unity of the mortal races against the monster threat

## Headquarters

The Council Accord convenes in a rotating location, meeting in each capital in turn. A neutral council hall exists in Weaveheart for formal sessions.
